title: Third Battle Of Panipat
definition: A decisive military conflict fought on 14 January 1761 between the Maratha Empire and the invading forces of the Afghan King Ahmad Shah Abdali, supported by Indian allies.
importanceInUpsc: It marks a watershed moment in Indian history, signaling the end of Maratha hegemony in North India and creating a power vacuum that facilitated British colonial expansion.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Third Battle Of Panipat.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
